title: The category of dotted arrows is independent of the chosen 2-morphism when the inertia of the target is proper
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that when the inertia of the target is proper, the category of dotted arrows in the valuative criterion is independent up to noncanonical equivalence of the choice of the filling 2-morphism, and that the existence of a dotted arrow is equivalent to the existence of a merely 2-commutative triangle (author lemma at source lines 9150-9168, label lemma-cat-dotted-arrows-independent). The proof (source lines 9170-9184) forms the automorphism of the object over the fraction field obtained by comparing the two 2-morphisms, extends it over the valuation ring by the valuative criterion of properness, and uses the extension to define the equivalence between the two categories of dotted arrows (proof lines 9171-9183). The extension step is the content. H2.
